notes: Initial contact: AE Maya intro call 2025-11-12. Very latency-sensitive; product team owns latency KPIs.
Use-case: real-time chat for banking support + fraud scoring pipeline that uses reranking; both must meet strict p95 windows.
Customer quote: 'we need predictable tail latency under load — spikes kill conversions' (product lead).
Primary ask: Dedicated GPU pool with throughput guarantees (200–300 qps steady, 400 burst) and explicit p50/p95/p99 SLOs for streaming and non-streaming flows.
POC plan agreed: 3-week Dedicated POC (staging infra) with synthetic load and recorded client SDK traces. POC success metrics defined below.
Negotiation point: whether SLO measurement is client-side (SDK RTT) or server-side (generation finish). Customer wants client-side by default; Redwood prefers server-side for capacity accounting.
Security: SOC2 and SSO required; data residency flagged for EU customers in a later phase. KMS integration scoped for PII at rest.
Commercial: customer requests SLA credit language tied to p95 breaches. Legal to review proposed SLA template (AE -> Legal).
Resource ask: dedicated 8xA100-equivalent GPUs for POC, option to scale to 24 GPUs if throughput needs confirmed.
Metric definitions (draft): p50/p95/p99 measured on 'time-to-last-token' for non-streaming text-gen; streaming measured as two metrics: time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-to-stream-complete (TSC).

Measurement alignment proposal: report both server-side and client-side percentiles. Server-side = model emit finish timestamp minus request received; client-side = SDK recorded end minus SDK start (includes network/SDK overhead).
POC success thresholds (proposal): non-streaming p50 <= 85ms, p95 <= 320ms, p99 <= 700ms at 250 qps steady; streaming TTFT p95 <= 220ms, TSC p95 <= 550ms at target concurrency.
Observability: use Redwood Console dashboards (per-route token breakdown) + exported traces to their Datadog account. Will validate prefix/KV cache hit rates during POC.
Operational notes: enable continuous batching set to conservative defaults initially; test impacts of larger batch sizes on p99 under tail loads.

POC milestone log: week1: baseline profiling + kernel selection; week2: throughput tuning and streaming behavior; week3: run 24h soak and generate SLA report.
Open question from SE: do we use 'token-complete' or 'response-complete' as end event for multi-part streaming responses (affects TSC measurement).
Customer requests a monthly performance report template showing p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, batching stats, and cache hit ratios.
Potential upsell: if Dedicated meets SLOs, customer is interested in Private (VPC) onboarding for regulated product lines in APAC.
